title: npc_text
summary: MSUI transcribes the byte-carved $-token grammar into QuestTextMacroLaw.Expand: exactly the B/C/E/G/N/R/T/W set, decimal prefix consumed ahead of every token (and lost with an unaccepted one), case-as-output-switch for $R/$C, the $G/$T gender branch with ==0 first-arm semantics, marker-and-spaces-consumed malformed-branch behavior, and re-emitted $ on failure. The world-state table is live: SMSG_INIT_WORLD_STATES and SMSG_UPDATE_WORLD_STATE are both parsed into _questWorldStates and $nW/$nE read it (negated key for E, %d render). The subject is the self player's name + race/class/gender from descriptors, applied via ExpandQuestText at the gossip/quest/mail feed seams - the same seam set Benilla routes.
